title: Embeddings & Representation
blurb: How text became vectors you can search. This is the stack ResearchIT itself runs on.

anchors.note: Bidirectional pretraining. The starting point for almost every encoder that follows.
BERT embeddings are poor for similarity out of the box; a siamese objective fixes it. The paper that made semantic search practical.
Contrastive learning where dropout alone provides the positive pair. Startlingly simple, startlingly strong.
Weakly-supervised contrastive pretraining at scale, and a demonstration that data curation carries most of the gain.
The BGE family, including the BGE-M3 model this app encodes with. Multilingual, multi-granularity, dense plus sparse.
The benchmark that made embedding models comparable. Also a caution: leaderboard rank does not transfer to your domain.
Train one vector that can be truncated to many sizes. The way to cut vector storage without re-encoding a corpus.
